edits.new:
An activity can cover specific forms, established participant roles, and things used or intended for performing it, when the child's own meaning establishes that connection.

An explicitly included aspect of information covered through a permitted connection retains that connection while it concerns the same qualifying kind or activity. Its linguistic, psychological or other descriptive character alone does not establish independence. Independent associated topics do not inherit the connection.
edits.old: An activity can cover specific forms, established participant roles, and things used or intended for performing it, when the child's own meaning establishes that connection. Specified aspects of a kind with a qualifying role remain covered even when those aspects do not perform the activity; independent associated topics do not inherit the role.
